course.title: PHYS 105 Midterm 1
course.bank_intro: One worked problem per item. Do it on paper, photograph it, and have Claude grade it against the folded rubric.
course.tracker_intro: Tracks the three Midterm 1 items from first pre-test to mastered.
course.loop:
1. Pre-test each item on paper, cold.
2. Photograph the work and have Claude grade it step by step.
3. Drill anything under 80% from its concept page.
4. Post-test on a fresh problem at least a day later.
course.grading: Each rubric step is marked Y or N. An attempt passes at 80% of steps.

plan.head: Post-tests
items: Post-test every weak or shaky item

course.schedule_note: Keep the last week for post-tests.

items.title: Constant acceleration
items.logic: List what you know, pick the equation missing the unknown you don't need, solve.
items.q: A cyclist moving at $4\ 	ext{m/s}$ accelerates at $1.5\ 	ext{m/s}^2$ for $6\ 	ext{s}$. How far does she travel, and how fast is she going at the end?

items.title: Newton's second law
items.logic: Draw the forces, find the net force along the motion, divide by mass.
items.q: A $5\ 	ext{kg}$ crate is pushed with $30\ 	ext{N}$ across a floor with $10\ 	ext{N}$ of friction. Find its acceleration.
rubric: push 30 N forward, friction 10 N back

items.title: Work and energy
items.logic: Potential energy lost becomes kinetic energy gained when there is no friction.
items.q: A $0.5\ 	ext{kg}$ ball rolls without friction down a ramp $1.8\ 	ext{m}$ high. Take $g = 10\ 	ext{m/s}^2$. How fast is it moving at the bottom?
rubric: Set energy lost equal to energy gained.
